title: Site-Condition Addition on In-Place Home Resale Inspections
content:
**Community operations memo — site condition and the pre-sale inspection.** On an In-Place Home Resale package whose inspection fee is above 0.00, the initial inspection charge carries a site-condition addition, one of the inspection additions billed with that charge. The site-condition addition follows the community rule violation notices served under the Community Rules & Site Care plan record of the seller's site that are fewer than 12 whole calendar months old on the day the inspection charge is worked out: 2 or more such notices add 30.00, exactly one such notice adds 15.00, and none adds nothing.

**What is counted.** Rule violation notices recorded under the Community Rules & Site Care plan record that belongs to the seller's site — the site of the seller's lease — whose notice date lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the charge is worked out. Only rule violation notices are counted; other entries under the plan record are not.

| Notices fewer than 12 whole months old | Site-condition addition |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 30.00 |
| exactly 1 | 15.00 |
| none | 0.00 |

## Counting whole months (charge worked out on 15 March 2026, hypothetical)

| Notice dated | Whole calendar months to 15 March 2026 | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2025 | 11 | yes |
| 15 March 2025 | 12 | no |
| 2 February 2026 | 1 | yes |
| 30 January 2025 | 13 | no |

With the four notices above, two are counted (16 March 2025 and 2 February 2026), so the addition is 30.00. Had only the 2 February 2026 notice been counted, it would be 15.00.
